_retired: rule_rate_limit_city_and_teachers_LOG (committed 2026-09-22, never applied live -- check:firewall-drift was red on it) was removed 2026-09-28: the site is now fronted by Cloudflare, so every request Vercel sees carries a Cloudflare egress IP. Any rule keyed on ["ip"] therefore keys on a handful of shared addresses and would fire on ALL traffic at once; flipped to deny it is a self-DoS. Per-IP rate limiting now belongs at Cloudflare (which sees the real client IP), never here. Bot-classification rules (bot_protection) are unaffected.

rules.name: Bypass revalidate webhook
rules.description: Supabase's pg_net calls this path to purge the CDN cache on content writes. Bot Protection would flag it as non-browser traffic and challenge it, which pg_net cannot solve -- silently breaking cache invalidation. Must run before Bot Management.
